name: tsoa-duplicate-model-repro
description: Standalone TSOA repro project for duplicate model definition failures in metadata generation, covering @tsoaModel canonical selection, duplicate logical files reached through different paths, and source contracts colliding with built client declaration models.

scripts.build: tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --target ES2022 --module CommonJS --moduleResolution Node --strict --skipLibCheck --rootDir client/src --outDir client/dist client/src/api.ts
